english.note: This is the all-purpose term for a physical yard behind a house.
Use 後院 when the house yard is specifically at the back of the house.

examples.english: We’re grilling in the backyard at home.
examples.traditional: 我哋喺屋企後院燒嘢食。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 uk1 kei2 hau6 jyun2 siu1 je5 sik6

examples.english: We’re having a barbecue in the yard behind the house.
